title: Kicked Zanzibari Wholesome Cocoa Pancakes
description: These low-calorie-friendly cocoa pancakes are light and comforting, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack. Bitter in taste, they add a unique twist to traditional pancake recipes.

ingredients.name: flax seeds
ingredients.notes: to add a bit of crunch and nutrition

instructions: In a bowl, whisk together cocoa powder and milk until smooth.
Mix in almond flour, chia seeds, vanilla extract, coconut oil, and salt. Stir gently to combine.
Pressure-cook the mixture for 5 minutes at high pressure on your appliance.
Allow it to cool slightly before carefully pouring into a non-stick pan.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve hot with fresh fruit or honey for a delightful touch.
